chunks.subject: AP Macroeconomics
chunks.title: Q1 Long FRQ (10 points) — Set 2: unemployment, Phillips curve & government budget
chunks.content: AP Macroeconomics FRQ 1 (Long), 10 points, one per element (Points 1–10), graphs plus state/explain answers. Set 2 answer key highlights: state the actual unemployment rate (e.g., 10%); draw a correctly labeled SRPC (and LRPC with the relevant point); state that the government budget moves into deficit and explain that government spending exceeds revenue; plus additional graph and state/explain elements on aggregate demand/supply and fiscal effects. Same 10-point structure as Set 1. Common failure: unlabeled graphs; 'state' answers without the required 'explain'; miscomputing or misreading the unemployment rate.

chunks.content: Q1 (Set 2) scored 5/10 — earned the graph-labeling and simpler state points but lost the explain-dependent points (the fiscal/budget mechanism and other state-and-explain items). Illustrates graph/state points earned, explain points missed.

chunks.content: Q1 (Set 2) scored 3/10 — earned about three elements (a labeled graph and one or two simple state answers), losing the shifts and the state-and-explain reasoning points. Illustrates a low response with fragments of the graph and statements but no multi-step reasoning.
